comment: New-moon start: the moon message forces --More-- on the welcome message, and Escape answers it. options.c ask_do_tutorial()'s menu reaches wintty.c tty_display_nhwindow(NHW_MENU), whose tty_display_nhwindow(WIN_MESSAGE) returns at once because WIN_STOP shares WIN_CANCELLED's bit; tty_clear_nhwindow() then erases the moon message without a second --More--. n declines the tutorial.
